globalThis.comparison = (() => {
  const target = document.createElement('div');
  target.style.cssText = 'width:37px;height:11px';
  document.body.appendChild(target);
  const result = {};
  const cases = [
    ['atRule', '@unknown{}', 'layout unsupported: stylesheet at-rule'],
    ['nesting', '.item{& span{width:1px}}', 'layout unsupported: nested stylesheet rule'],
    ['forgiving', ':is(.item,:unknown){width:1px}', 'layout unsupported: forgiving selector recovery'],
    ['selectors', Array.from({length:65},(_,i)=>'.item'+i).join(',')+'{width:1px}', 'layout unsupported: stylesheet selectors'],
    ['rules', '.item{width:1px}'.repeat(1025), 'resource limit: stylesheet rules'],
    ['declarations', '.item{'+Array.from({length:1025},(_,i)=>'--item'+i+':1px;').join('')+'}', 'layout unsupported: CSS declaration limit'],
  ];
  const wrap = (source, depth) => {
    for (let i=0;i<depth;i++) source = ['@layer outer{','@media all{','@supports (width:1px){'][i%3]+source+'}';
    return source;
  };
  for (const [name,source,error] of cases) {
    for (const depth of [1,2,3]) {
      const sheet = document.createElement('style');
      sheet.textContent = wrap(source,depth);
      document.head.appendChild(sheet);
      let message = '';
      try { target.getBoundingClientRect(); } catch (failure) { message = failure.message; }
      sheet.remove();
      result[name+depth] = message.endsWith(error);
      result[name+'Recovery'+depth] = target.getBoundingClientRect().width === 37;
    }
  }
  const inactive = document.createElement('style');
  inactive.textContent = '@layer inactive{@media not all{@unknown{}}}';
  document.head.appendChild(inactive);
  result.inactive = target.getBoundingClientRect().width === 37;
  inactive.remove();
  target.remove();
  return result;
})();
